chunks: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

Indeed, the deeds of the children are based on the deeds of their fathers; whoever finds in his good deeds a good deed from his fathers, it is for him, and whoever finds in his good deeds an evil deed from his fathers, it is for him.
And Allah knows what is in the breasts.
ai.seo_question: Do children inherit the sins or good deeds of their parents in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq utilizes this narration to support the Shia doctrine of *al-Karamah al-Akhlaqiyyah* (moral inheritance), distinguishing it from the Sunni view of *al-Kaffarah* (expiation) by emphasizing that righteous ancestors' deeds serve as a spiritual shield or merit for their descendants. This concept highlights the intergenerational spiritual connectivity within the family unit, where the piety of forefathers can elevate the status of their progeny in the Hereafter, provided they maintain their own faith.
